item.title: Queensland highlights building and physical environment considerations for ECEC services

item.title: First regional public preschool in more than 20 years opens as NSW expands early learning access

item.description: The Federal Government has introduced legislation to secure funding for the 15 per cent early childhood educator pay rise, with services also set to face new safety requirements as a condition of receiving the payment.

item.title: NSW announces major funding reforms for long day care services from 2027
item.description: NSW long day care providers will face a significant change to their funding arrangements from 2027, with program payments to services set to cease and a new model focused on increased fee relief for eligible children to replace Start Strong for Long Day Care.
